title: Warm words with fair terms

captions.emotions: Feeling that your agreement is fair

meaning: An attentive conversation lets you clarify mutual promises so that shared values take the form of fair terms for both of you.
text: Behind a pleasant offer of help, you may want to hear an understandable commitment. In Vishuddha, the Empress in the physical position helps a request unfold: describing what is wanted, offering possibilities and following the other person’s thought attentively. The Hierophant in energy sustains respect for the meaning of a shared promise. Words deserve trust because they mean something to you both. Justice in emotions brings satisfaction in fair terms. A warm exchange becomes more tangible when agreement recognises each person’s involvement rather than remaining a beautiful general phrase.

For example, before a family lunch you promise to “get everything ready together”. Discussing the menu gradually brings out particular requests: who can buy the food and who can arrive earlier. **A shared value becomes audible in a precise promise.** You can contribute in different ways and spend different amounts of time. What matters is understanding the terms and being free to accept them aloud while still enjoying the occasion you are planning.

The difficulty appears if feeling completely fair requires checking every word. A conversation that began with hospitality becomes an audit of equal contributions, and spontaneous participation disappears among clarifications. The shared meaning of the promise remains good. It is easier to preserve when precision helps you hear an actual request without demanding identical forms of involvement.
